system.description:
• Effect: Shapeshift into any beast or beast-like monster of Level no greater than half your Druid level, rounded down (minimum Level 1), once per day, choosing the form fresh each time (GM's call on what qualifies; a wolf, giant spider or dire badger are all fair game, but intelligent or magical creatures are not). Lasts up to 1 hour or until you choose to revert. You take the form's whole stat block from Monsters & Treasure: its HP, AC, attacks, saves and movement. You keep your own mind, personality and Wisdom-based abilities, and you cannot cast spells in a form that cannot speak. When the form drops to 0 HP you return to your own form with the HP you had when you changed (see Changing Shape in Spellcasting in Arneyan).
  • 3rd level: usable twice per day
  • 6th level: usable three times per day
  • 9th level: usable four times per day
  • 15th level: usable five times per day
  • 24th level: usable six times per day

activities.name: Wild Shape
activities.text: Shapeshift into a beast of Level up to half your Druid level for up to 1 hour, taking its whole stat block.

activities.name: Wild Shape (Deepened)
activities.text: Shapeshift into a beast of Level up to your Druid level and gain temporary HP equal to twice your Druid level.
